name: Plant Conservation and Restoration Management cooperative agreements
summary: US federal cooperative agreements for native seed collection, nursery production and native plant community restoration on public lands. The FY26 notice (L26AS00050) is archived.

amount.note: Program funding of $2,500,000 for 50 expected awards

eligibility.rule: Is not an individual or for-profit organization
Not applying through BLM Idaho, Utah or the National Interagency Fire Center
Does not hire interns or crews under the Public Lands Corps Act of 1993
Is registered in SAM.gov before applying

documents: SF-424A budget information form, for non-construction projects
SF-424C budget information form, for construction projects
SF-429 cover page and Attachment B, for real property
SF-LLL disclosure of lobbying activities, when required
Current and pending support, for research projects

effort.quote: During the eligibility review, the application is checked for timely submission, completed packages (see Application Documents above) and alignment with the requirements of this announcement.
Eligible applications will be evaluated in an objective and unbiased manner using the following merit review criteria:
Prior to making an award, the applicant will be assessed for their level of risk per 2 CFR 200.206.

eligibility.quote: Individuals and For-Profit Organizations are ineligible to apply for awards under this NOFO.
Idaho, National Interagency Fire Center (NIFC), and Utah will not be accepting applications under this Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO).
This program NOFO does not support entities hiring interns or crews under the Public Lands Corps Act of 1993.
Before applying, all applicants except individuals applying as a natural person must be registered in SAM.gov.

after_award.quote: Submit Federal Financial reports and Program Performance reports.
